# One name, one meaning at file scope.

# Unexported members are private to their declaring package. Only the type name
# is gated on import, so without this its unexported members came along.
! sngl check private_field.sngl
stderr '_hidden is unexported'

! sngl check private_method.sngl
stderr '_secret is unexported'

# Exported members through the same import are fine, and a package reaches its
# own unexported members.
sngl check exported_ok.sngl
stdout 'exported_ok.sngl: ok'

sngl check own_package.sngl
stdout 'own_package.sngl: ok'

# Two declarations of one name.
! sngl check redeclared.sngl
stderr 'redeclared in this file'

# Two imports claiming one alias.
! sngl check dup_alias.sngl
stderr 'already bound at file scope by an import alias'

# A declaration may not take a name an import alias already binds — every
# qualified reference through that alias would break.
! sngl check decl_vs_alias.sngl
stderr 'already bound at file scope by an import alias'

# A declaration may shadow a dot-imported name: only one of the two is written
# here, so there is no ambiguity. This is the stdlib override story.
sngl check shadows_dot.sngl
stdout 'shadows_dot.sngl: ok'

# A dot import may shadow a built-in for the same reason.
sngl check shadows_builtin.sngl
stdout 'shadows_builtin.sngl: ok'


# The one-name rule reaches free functions, consts and vars, not just types and
# components. These live in the package's root symbol table rather than its
# type or component maps, and lifting them unclaimed made which package a bare
# name referred to depend on the order the imports were written in.
! sngl check dup_dot_func.sngl
stderr 'lifts "Greet", already lifted by dot import of'

! sngl check dup_dot_const.sngl
stderr 'lifts "LIMIT", already lifted by dot import of'

# Duplicate bindings that used to be silently last-wins.
! sngl check dup_const.sngl
stderr '"K" redeclared in this file'

! sngl check dup_component_var.sngl
stderr 'y is already declared in this scope'

! sngl check dup_loop_var.sngl
stderr 'k is already declared in this scope'

# A namespace the stdlib exposes may still be imported by name: both bindings
# denote the same package, so this is a restated name, not an ambiguous one.
sngl check restate_intrinsic.sngl
stdout 'restate_intrinsic.sngl: ok'

-- w/lib.sngl --
import . "sngl://std"

struct Box {
    v int = 0
    _hidden int = 0
}

func Box._secret() => 42

func Box.Shown() => 1
-- other/lib.sngl --
import . "sngl://std"

struct Box {
    other int = 0
}
-- mycolor/lib.sngl --
struct color {
    tag string = "mine"
}
-- private_field.sngl --
import . "sngl://std"
import w "w"

func f(b w.Box) => b._hidden

component main {
    text(value="x")
}
-- private_method.sngl --
import . "sngl://std"
import w "w"

func f(b w.Box) => b._secret()

component main {
    text(value="x")
}
-- exported_ok.sngl --
import . "sngl://std"
import w "w"

func f(b w.Box) => b.Shown()

func g(b w.Box) => b.v

component main {
    text(value="x")
}
-- own_package.sngl --
import . "sngl://std"

struct Local {
    _p int = 0
}

func Local._m() => 1

func use(l Local) => l._m() + l._p

component main {
    text(value="x")
}
-- redeclared.sngl --
import . "sngl://std"

func dup() => 1

func dup() => 2

component main {
    text(value="x")
}
-- dup_alias.sngl --
import . "sngl://std"
import x "w"
import x "other"

component main {
    text(value="x")
}
-- decl_vs_alias.sngl --
import . "sngl://std"
import helper "w"

component helper() {
    text(value="x")
}

component main {
    text(value="y")
}
-- shadows_dot.sngl --
import . "sngl://std"

component text(value string) {
    button(text=value)
}

component main {
    text(value="mine")
}
-- shadows_builtin.sngl --
import . "sngl://std"
import . "mycolor"

func f() => color{tag="x"}.tag

component main {
    text(value=f())
}
-- pa/lib.sngl --
import . "sngl://std"

func Greet() => "from A"
-- pb/lib.sngl --
import . "sngl://std"

func Greet() => "from B"
-- pc/lib.sngl --
import . "sngl://std"

const LIMIT = 1
-- pd/lib.sngl --
import . "sngl://std"

const LIMIT = 2
-- dup_dot_func.sngl --
import . "sngl://std"
import . "pa"
import . "pb"

component main {
    text(value=Greet())
}
-- dup_dot_const.sngl --
import . "sngl://std"
import . "pc"
import . "pd"

component main {
    text(value="{LIMIT}")
}
-- dup_const.sngl --
import . "sngl://std"

const K = 1
const K = 2

component main {
    text(value="x")
}
-- dup_component_var.sngl --
import . "sngl://std"

component main {
    var y int = 1
    var y int = 2
    text(value="x")
}
-- dup_loop_var.sngl --
import . "sngl://std"

component main {
    var m map<string, string> = {}
    for k, k = m {
        text(value=k)
    }
}
-- restate_intrinsic.sngl --
import . "sngl://std"
import "internal://lower"

func make() => lower.CreateNode("text")

component main {
    text(value="x")
}
